# Project Bioengineering

### loading the data

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install(c("SummarizedExperiment", "DESeq2"), update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(DESeq2)

base_dir <- "~/Documents/27200/macrophage_subset12_salmon"

# 1. Load SummarizedExperiment
se <- readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "salmon.merged.gene.SummarizedExperiment.rds"))

# 2. Load Metadata that is inside the folder pipeline_info
meta_path <- file.path(base_dir, "pipeline_info/sample_metadata_macrophage_subset12.tsv")
meta <- read.delim(meta_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 3. check collumn names and order 
head(meta)
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample
meta <- meta[colnames(se), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(se), rownames(meta)))

# 4. clean the IDs Ensembl
colData(se) <- DataFrame(meta)
rownames(se) <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(se))

# just to make sure that everything works
se
```
